inScope: This record, committed first on the existing branch from baseCommit.

Typography, comparison: the present pairing as the control; the same two families with their faces declared otherwise; and a small number of other openly licensed families, each from its official source with its licence and digests recorded, kept outside the product. The same samples for every configuration; which faces the browser takes, how many runs it shapes, layout time, size; then the best one or two measured against the control with the reuse suite of test/perf/run.mjs. One recommendation.

Typography, product: only what keeps the approved families (Inter for Latin, Vazirmatn for Arabic script) and the two visible choices, Original and Readela Sans — the way the faces are declared and matched to text, by the browser's own font selection — and only if the measurements support it. A replacement of a family is prepared as an experimental build and left for the owner.
The colour-scheme listener: the page's colours are measured again when the system changes between light and dark, without an error, and the listener is removed when Readela is turned off.

Ownership: one decision, used by colour, typography, direction and bookmark targets alike, of which parts of a response are reading text and which stay the site's whole; the same with a reading theme on and with Original appearance.
The first painted frame of a part that stays the site's is readable, from colours already measured, with no measurement added to the moment of arrival.

The last response under a reading theme: ordinary reading text of a response keeps the theme through arrival, streaming, completion, a reload, a change of conversation and a change of theme; a part that is the site's own stays whole.

Bookmarks, one writer: the background component performs every change of the stored bookmarks (save, update, remove, and the row a conversation is learned to belong to), one after another, each against what is stored at that moment, and answers only once the browser has stored it. No state kept between changes, no timer, no request, no permission beyond storage. A failure is answered as a failure.

Return: never report as reached a place that is not the saved one. What a candidate must agree with before it is accepted, in a long conversation of which the site keeps only a part in the document, and with passages that repeat.

Auto direction: a Persian sentence that carries many Latin terms reads right-to-left, by a signal from the sentence itself and its context, while English paragraphs, figures with units and structured numeric layouts stay as they are. Code, addresses and mathematics are not touched.
Removal of logic the above makes redundant, where it is directly related.

The measuring script, where a comparison of fonts needs a small addition; unit and end-to-end tests and fixtures for the defects reproduced; documentation and dated evidence made necessary by the above; local Chrome and Firefox builds for the owner's review; an accurate description of pull request 9.
A final comparison of no extension against the build eligible for integration, with the matched suite, over about an hour of work.

externalCapabilities.note: Load-bearing behaviour of the browsers. Each is to be confirmed by a probe on the installed versions before the code that depends on it is settled; a difference between a browser's documentation and what it does blocks that part.

items.capability: A message sent to the background component is answered asynchronously, and the browser keeps the component running until the answer is given: in Chrome an extension service worker, in Firefox an event page.
items.authority: developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/develop/concepts/messaging and .../service-workers/lifecycle; MDN runtime.onMessage and background scripts.
items.probe: The end-to-end suite sends changes to the background component in both browsers, overlapping, and reads what is stored; and sends one after the component has been stopped.

items.capability: Changes made one after another by a single background component cannot interleave: its handlers share one thread, and a chain of promises there orders them. A component the browser stops between two changes starts the next from what is stored.
items.authority: The same pages; storage.local has no transaction of its own.
items.probe: A unit test of the ordering with a storage double that answers late and out of order; the end-to-end check above.

items.capability: A browser takes each character from the first face of a family list whose unicode-range holds it; a character outside the range of the first family is drawn by the next, and starts a new shaping run.
items.authority: drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts, the unicode-range descriptor and font matching; measured on Chrome 154 on 2026-10-12 (37 runs for a Persian sentence of 19 words).
items.probe: The run count of the same samples under every configuration, in Chrome and in Firefox where it can be read.

risk.tierNote: Product rigor. Nothing is published by this work.
risk.dataLossNote: Bookmarks are the reader's own data. The change of who writes them keeps the stored form, the limit of 1000 and the rule that none is dropped; a build that can neither read nor write them through the new path must say so and change nothing.
risk.targetedVerification: Manifest contract tests: permissions stay ["storage"], three commands with no suggested key, content-script matches and web-accessible resources as the packaged fonts require. A source test that the background component holds no timer, no network call, nothing kept between two changes, and no listener but the command's and the message's; that the page code creates no element and listens for no key. Unit tests of changes that overlap, arrive out of order and fail, against a storage double; end-to-end checks of the same in Chrome and Firefox, with the stored object read back, at the limit of 1000, and after the component was stopped. A check that a change of the system's colour scheme raises no error and renews the measured colours, and that turning Readela off removes the listener. Fixtures of a response made of the site's components: every part that stays the site's keeps its direction, font, size and colours and is no bookmark target, on its first frame and after, under both themes and under Original; reading text keeps the theme through arrival, streaming and completion. A long conversation of which only a part is in the document, with repeated passages: a return reaches the saved place or says it could not. Direction: the sentences the owner reported and their English counterparts. Measurements with the matched suite.
